findings: Claim-only duplicate resume returns into native previousImplementation before first preparation completes, risking missing headers/start/completion under concurrent or reentrant entry.
Removing the claim at completion plus task.state is insufficient: completed interception may run before native state setter updates task.state.

scope_amendment_before_implementation.reason: Independent source review proves one-file claim-only repair cannot order native resume or retain cancellation callbacks during preparation. Expand only the existing internal resume forwarding seam, not scene/routing behavior.
scope_amendment_before_implementation.design: Weak identity-keyed task preparation phases; queue each original resume continuation while preparing; freeze request and enqueue start before buffered callback work; publish ready then forward outside lock; terminal weak tombstone prevents reentry after completion. No callbacks/native forwarding under lock.
scope_amendment_before_implementation.observable_limit: A duplicate arriving during preparation returns before its original implementation executes; concurrent duplicates are forwarded on the preparation owner thread. Preserve each original call, test layered swizzles, and require independent compatibility review; do not claim arbitrary third-party same-stack/thread transparency.

Preparation-time automatic bodies above512KB stay complete while registered bodies retain upstream discard policy
Terminal observation before first claim blocks reinstrumentation despite stale native state
